kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the user to be deleted belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the user to be deleted belongs.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的用户所在堡垒机的地域ID。
地域id和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user to be deleted.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the user ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id
